headline_item.title_en: Artificial Analysis: Gemini 4 Neon trails only Claude Fable 5.2 and GPT-6.2 Astra on the Intelligence Index and rivals Opus 5.5 on coding at a much lower cost (Artificial Analysis)
headline_item.event_summary_zh: 谷歌推出Gemini 4 Neon模型，在智力指数评分中位列第三，且大幅降低了推理成本与任务耗时
headline_item.event_summary_en: Google DeepMind released Gemini 4 Neon, which scored 61 on the Artificial Intelligence Index, outperforming Gemini 4 Carbon. It delivers coding agent performance competitive with Claude 5.5 series at significantly lower cost and latency, now available via Google API and enterprise platforms.
core_facts_zh: 【核心事件】谷歌深度思维在Gemini API与企业平台：发布Gemini 4 Neon模型，优化任务成本与处理速度
【起因与机理】旨在通过模型轻量化与高推理效率，在企业级任务中构筑成本竞争力
【关键技术规格】Gemini 4 Neon模型在智力指数及代码智能体任务中表现优异。
【各方立场与态度】已通过API及企业平台全面商用，直接对标Claude 5.5系列。
core_facts_en: [Core Event] Google DeepMind: Launched Gemini 4 Neon with improved cost-efficiency and processing speed
[Root Cause & Mechanism] To secure competitive advantage in enterprise tasks through model optimization
[Key Metrics] 44 per task, ~17% less than Carbon ($7).
[Key Position & Outlook] Commercial availability via API and enterprise platforms targets Claude 5.5 competition.
headline_item.industry_impact_zh: 谷歌通过高频率迭代（七周内发布四款模型）强行压低AI推理的单位经济成本，旨在通过“速度换份额”策略对抗Anthropic在代码与复杂推理领域的先发优势。此举进一步明确了基座模型竞争已进入由效能比（Performance-per-Dollar）主导的深水存量博弈阶段。
headline_item.industry_impact_en: Google’s rapid iteration cycle signals a shift to a 'velocity-for-market-share' strategy, prioritizing cost-efficiency to challenge Anthropic's lead in coding and complex reasoning. The market is clearly pivoting toward a focus on performance-per-dollar as the primary lever for enterprise adoption.

headlines.title_zh: 英伟达芯片流向中国军方风险调查
headlines.title_en: How Nvidia Chips Ended Up Within Reach of China’s Military
headlines.event_summary_zh: 英伟达芯片通过中间商及关联实验室流入中国敏感机构，引发美方对供应链合规及地缘安全的深度审查
headlines.event_summary_en: Nvidia chips were routed through the Singapore-based firm Megaspeed to Alibaba-related entities, which maintain ties with the Zhejiang Lab, raising U.S. concerns over high-end chip access for military-linked AI research. Despite personal connections, the multi-layered supply chain and obfuscation tactics have significantly complicated regulatory compliance.
core_facts_zh: 【核心事件】英伟达(Nvidia)、Megaspeed、阿里巴巴、浙江实验室：通过中间商实现芯片采购，并关联至具有军方背景的AI实验室
【起因与机理】旨在规避美国贸易限制，获取高性能计算资源以进行战争模拟与网络攻防研究
【调查与监管诉求】英伟达芯片经由中间商流向涉及军事背景的科研实验室。
【各方立场与态度】英伟达面临重大合规压力，未来供应链审查趋严。
core_facts_en: [Core Event] Nvidia, Megaspeed, Alibaba, Zhejiang Lab: Utilizing intermediaries for chip procurement linked to military-affiliated AI research
[Root Cause & Mechanism] To circumvent U.S. trade restrictions and acquire high-performance computing for tactical AI applications
[Key Fact Detail] Nvidia chips funneled to military-affiliated labs through intermediaries.
[Industry Impact & Outlook] Nvidia faces heightened compliance pressure and stricter supply chain audits.
headlines.industry_impact_zh: 此事件暴露了半导体贸易管制的“最后三公里”漏洞，即通过海外贸易壳公司与关联科研机构的合规盲区，规避高性能算力出口审查。对于英伟达而言，这意味着其必须从单纯的“产品销售合规”向“全生命周期终端客户合规”转型，否则将面临极大的地缘制裁法律风险。
headlines.industry_impact_en: This incident exposes the 'last mile' loopholes in semiconductor export controls, where shell entities and affiliated labs bypass scrutiny. Nvidia must transition from product-level compliance to full-lifecycle end-user verification, or risk severe geopolitical and legal repercussions.

celebrity.author: Aravind Srinivas
celebrity.quote_zh:
过去几天，我们推出了三个新的 API：
困惑监视器：事件可编程警报
Perplexity Orchestrator：跨边界和开放权重模型的基于任务的路由
Perplexity Context：从 URL 到代理可用内容的批处理模式转换

我们的 API 业务同比增长了 4.3 倍，年运行率达到 9 位数。 Perplexity 拥有最先进的网络搜索、决策模型（在 Openrouter 上增长最快）以及法学硕士和决策模型的搜索基础。我们才刚刚开始。关注@perplexitydevs 进行定期更新。
celebrity.quote_en:
Last few days, we launched three new APIs: 
Perplexity Monitor: programmable alerts on events
Perplexity Orchestrator: task based routing across frontier and open-weight models  
Perplexity Context: batch-mode transformation from URLs to usable content for agents 

Our API business has grown 4.3x YoY and tracks at a 9-figure annual run rate. Perplexity has the state-of-the-art web search, decision models (fastest growing on Openrouter), and search grounding for LLMs and decision models. We’re just getting started. Follow @perplexitydevs for regular updates.
